title: Snow Day
author: Tadoku Note (original)
summary: 大雪で学校がお休みに。エマと弟は雪だるまを作り、ひとり暮らしの隣のおじいさんの家の前の雪かきをします。

source.note: Original text written for this app.

paragraphs: Emma wakes up early. Her room is very quiet. She goes to the window and opens the curtains. Everything is white!
There is snow on the street. There is snow on the cars and on the trees. The snow is very deep.
Emma runs to her brother’s room. “Leo! Leo! Wake up! Look outside!” Leo is six. He opens one eye. Then he opens the other eye. Then he jumps out of bed.
Their father is in the kitchen. He is listening to the radio. “No school today,” he says. “The buses can’t drive in this snow.”
They eat breakfast quickly. Then they put on their warm coats, their hats, their gloves and their boots. They go outside.
The air is very cold. Their noses are red. They make a snowman in the garden. He has a carrot nose and two black stones for eyes. Leo gives him an old hat. “His name is Mr. Cold,” Leo says.

Then Emma sees something. Across the street, there is an old man in front of his house. It is Mr. Brown. He lives alone. He has a shovel, and he is moving the snow. He moves very slowly. He stops and puts his hand on his back.
They get two shovels from the garage and cross the street. “Good morning, Mr. Brown!” says Emma. “Can we help you?”
Mr. Brown smiles. “Oh, thank you, children. My back is not young.”
Emma and Leo work hard. They move the snow from the door to the street. It takes one hour. Their arms are tired, but they are warm now.
“Wait here,” says Mr. Brown. He goes into his house. Then he comes out with two big cups. “Hot chocolate,” he says. “My wife always made it on snow days.”

The children drink the hot chocolate on Mr. Brown’s steps. It is sweet and very good. Mr. Brown tells them about the big snow of 1962. “The snow was up to the windows,” he says. “We didn’t go to school for a week!”
In the afternoon, the sun comes out. The snow starts to melt. But Mr. Cold is still in the garden, and Mr. Brown can see him from his window.
The next day, there is school again. But every snow day after that, Emma and Leo go across the street with their shovels. And every time, Mr. Brown makes hot chocolate.
